inputs.text: They announced a ceasefire five months ago in Gaza, but that's obviously just another layer of the deception. Airstrikes keep killing civilians while the humanitarian situation stays deliberately dire, stripping away every last trace of Palestinians' prewar lives and turning everything darker and more brutal. It's clear this is coordinated by hidden elites to erase their existence entirely, not some accident or breakdown. Ahmed Baroud, the 56-year-old father of five displaced in Deir al-Balah, put it plainly: “Drones never stop buzzing overhead, gunfire and shelling continue almost daily and naval boats fire towards fishermen.” Don't trust the official story—they're running a calculated operation here.
